metadata.scope: All synthetic. Current MVP discovery/catalogue/chat/Cart review only. Orders, payment labels, Handoffs, historical verified reviews, Trust showcases, delivery compensation and courier work are INTERNAL_SIMULATION only.
sources: Nov24 Decision Register D24-01–04, D24-13, D24-18
assumptions: All identities, counts, comments, reviews, Orders and analytic observations fictional. No real credentials, photos or coordinates.
Source marketplace records authoritative for existing IDs; extension does not overwrite catalogue stock, publication, taxonomy or current prices.
Guest is anonymous state, not a persisted ordinary account. Buyers switch with dataset/mode/account namespace.
Courier comments are a proposed shared-feedback experiment; only eligible Sellers can view shared moderated comments, never other Seller private notes or relationships.
Courier simulation methods are scenario-specific overrides, not live Seller settings. Historical order lines are snapshots; current stock does not prove historical availability.

All analytics are deterministic aggregate synthetic observations; audience includes fictional aggregate traffic beyond selectable accounts. No telemetry or real financial outcomes. Current/prior windows are 28 days each, end 2026-11-26; snapshot-day active Orders excluded from period charts. Scene like/save totals are capped by supplied snapshot counts; remainder is pre-window activity, not additional current engagement.
No data for draft seller; suspended Seller historical simulation records restricted to internal inspection; no current public display.
Team tasks/messages are coordination only, not new permission grants. Use existing actual permissions and surface restrictions.
Historical Trust badges visual only, do not compute earned Trust from these fixtures.

Rich simulation Order and Review history
